```javascript
import events from './events.json' with {type:'json'};

const TOOLS = [
  {
    name: 'events_list',
    description: 'List events with pagination',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        cursor: {type: 'string'},
        page_size: {type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3}
      },
      required: [],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }
];

export async function listTools() {
  return TOOLS;
}

function decodeCursor(cursor) {
  try {
    const decoded = Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64url').toString('utf8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (typeof parsed !== 'object' || parsed === null || Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
    }
    if (typeof parsed.i !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(parsed.i)) {
      throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
    }
    if (parsed.i < 0 || parsed.i > events.length) {
      throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
    }
    return parsed.i;
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
}

function encodeCursor(index) {
  const obj = {i: index};
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(obj), 'utf8').toString('base64url');
}

function validateArgs(args) {
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  const allowed = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  if ('cursor' in args && typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  if ('page_size' in args) {
    if (typeof args.page_size !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(args.page_size)) {
      throw new Error('Invalid page_size');
    }
    if (args.page_size < 1 || args.page_size > 3) {
      throw new Error('page_size out of range');
    }
  }
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  validateArgs(args);
  
  const pageSize = args.page_size ?? 2;
  let startIndex = 0;
  if (args.cursor) {
    startIndex = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  
  const page = events.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize);
  const nextStart = startIndex + pageSize;
  
  const result = {
    events: page,
    ...(nextStart < events.length ? {next_cursor: encodeCursor(nextStart)} : {})
  };
  
  return {
    content: [{type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result)}]
  };
}
```
